name: Bernardo
message: And blessed is the fruit of thy womb...

name: Bernardo
message: Pray for us sinners now and at the hour of our death.

name: Horatio
message: Well, then. What awful thing have you done this week that needs the Virgin's forgiveness?

name: Horatio
message: Gone whoring? Been reading salacious literature? Caught embedded in a sheep?

name: Bernardo
message: I have committed no sins that I know of.

name: Bernardo
message: And besides, card games are a sin! I ought to refuse your temptations... and Irma's too, for that matter. It leads to drinking and dancing. Awful business.

name: Horatio
message: Hmm. No cards? No drinking, no dancing? Well then. What does your God promise you that's so very compelling in return?

name: Bernardo
message: Mortal life is but a blink of an eye. As a soldier, I could die any day. But Heaven is eternal, and I will sit at God's side.

name: Horatio
message: That's correct, yes. I am a heathen. I prefer my devas and asuras. Some wisdom here, a little trickery there... Gods with real personality.
